basis: Round 28: Sirén's photograph of 三圣殿 (1918-35) from the court between 天王殿 and the hall, west of the axis: the hall's west bays draw wider than its east ones and its ridge falls to the right, so the camera stands south-west of the middle. The prior is held tight (0.5 m in plan, eye 1.5 ± 0.3 m) at about 29 m: left free, the fit ran 64 m back behind 天王殿 with a long lens, a place from which the hall cannot be seen. 50° lens assumed

Round 28: the Bundesarchiv view of about 1900 (Bild 137-000605) from the inner court south-west of 文殊亭: two faces of the octagon show, the south-west on the left and the south, with its four-leaf door as today (P0430), on the right of the near corner; the two men stand a few metres before the platform; 50° lens assumed; the octagon alone cannot tell this reading from its mirror (the camera south-east, the faces south and south-east): both fit at 0.19 m

Round 28: the gate today (2013) from the forecourt on the axis: the gate's 9.6 m body spans 442 px of 1280, about 27 m off with a 55° lens (assumed); the gate survives (repaired 2003), so the photograph tests the model's gate as it stands
